Customer Statements (Unpaid Invoices)

The Customer Statements Unpaid Invoices form is used to configure report parameters.

Select customers to generate statements showing only unpaid invoices.

Date

Select the date for the statement. Today uses the current date, while Custom lets you specify a date.

CustomDate

Enter the specific date when using Custom date type.

Theme

Select a theme to customize the appearance of printed statements.
